Hi Alex — quick technical notes to clarify options so you have something concrete to share with legal/security: 

1) Retention windows (logs & audit trails):
   - Default: 90 days for operational logs (diagnostics, request timing).
   - Audit bundles (full request+response + KV metadata) can be exported and snapshot-immutable stamped for longer-term storage on customer side. We support exporting bundles on-demand and scheduling daily exports.
   - Custom retention: configurable per-customer between 30 and 365 days for server-side retention (requires conversation on cost and storage policy).

2) Immutability & export chain of custody:
   - Exported audit bundles are signed (SHA256) and include a checksum manifest. We can optionally push exports directly to your S3 bucket (HealthSync-owned) with object-lock enabled for WORM-style immutability.

3) PHI / PII handling:
   - Options: (A) Private tenancy (best isolation) or (B) Shared tenancy with strict crypto separation + RBAC + filtered telemetry.
   - For shared tenancy, we enforce envelope encryption with customer KMS; access to plaintext requires a documented access workflow and is recorded in the audit trail.

4) Evidence / SOC2 items:
   - We can provide configuration screenshots, export samples, and a short checklist for SOC2 auditors. See retention-options.md (attached) for a short write-up.

Next steps from Redwood engineering: schedule a 30-min tech walk-through (we can demo export flow and show checksum manifests). Proposed slots: Mon 12/07 10am ET or Tue 12/08 2pm ET.

Cc-ing Marissa so she can own the export checklist and evidence delivery timeline in the MAP.
